subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Which single public metadata field name and cross-channel scope should OpenClaw support for ignored group-entry labels?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but adding any new config field is a public contract choice and the repository policy prefers one canonical current shape over aliases.

options.title: Use `label` cross-channel
options.body: Add one optional `label` string to relevant group/channel entry schemas and docs, making the field visibly metadata-only and avoiding confusion with runtime group-name matching.

options.title: Use `name` cross-channel
options.body: Add one optional `name` string consistently, matching account naming style but risking confusion with existing dangerous name-matching features.

options.title: Keep status quo
options.body: Leave group entries behavior-only and ask users to keep external notes for numeric or opaque group IDs.

recommendation.title: Use `label` cross-channel
recommendation.body: Add one optional `label` string to relevant group/channel entry schemas and docs, making the field visibly metadata-only and avoiding confusion with runtime group-name matching.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history match for strict config validation, the WhatsApp schema refactor, and prior review of this issue's config-contract tradeoff.
